title: Noon at the Zoo
lines: Dot went with her school to the zoo.
At noon Mom gave her a bag of food.
In the bag was a bun and a spoon.
A goat came up and took the whole bag!
Dot ran fast, but the goat was fast too.
It went up on the roof of the shed.
Dot made a big yell, but the goat sat.
Then a zoo man gave Dot a long tool.
She hooked the bag and got it back.
The food was gone, but the spoon was not.
Mom gave Dot some of her noon food.
Dot will keep her bag shut at the zoo.

questions.ask: What was in the bag of food?
questions.listenFor: A bun and a spoon. It is in the third line.

questions.ask: How did Dot get her bag back from the roof?
questions.listenFor: A zoo man gave her a long tool, and she hooked the bag with it. Yelling had not worked.

questions.ask: Which part of the zoo trip did you like best? Read me that line.
questions.listenFor: Any line. The goat up on the roof of the shed is a common pick. Reading it back keeps it honest.
